messages:
tia: heads-up: canary embeddings showing error-rate + latency since 436100-6m. deploybot flagged an alert.
deploybot: ALERT embed-canary err_rate=1.8% (threshold=0.5%), p95=710ms; autorevert=false.
ben: that coincides with the autoscaler tweak merged yesterday. Could be allocation thrash.
kai: stack traces show `alloc-fallback` and transient k8s pod restarts on embed-hosts.
tia: quick options: 1) staged unwind to previous build, 2) rollback autoscaler tweak, 3) throttle canary traffic. Thoughts?
ben: prefer staged unwind to v3.3.9. Minimizes variable surface. We'll pin pools after.
ops-oncall-bot: runbook check: manual unwind if err_rate>threshold for 10m OR customer errors >0.5%. Notify #cust-impact if >20m.
deploybot: action: `pause-rollout --target=canary-embed --by=tia`
tia: paused.
ben: executing staged unwind: `rollout revert --target=canary-embed --to=v3.3.9 --staged=3 --operator=ben`
deploybot: stage 1/3 succeeded. p95 dropped to 360ms, err_rate down to 0.3%.
kai: pinning dedicated pools to v3.3.9 now to prevent re-scheduling on the new image.
[deploybot] update: rollback complete for canary-embed. metadata set: release_state=unwound, pinned=v3.3.9, operator=ben
tia: drafting release-notes blurb and short customer-facing line: "Performance instability in embeddings canary; temporarily reverted to prior build while we investigate."
ops-oncall-bot: created incident I-2024-77 and assigned kai as postmortem owner. Action items queued: revert autoscaler tweak, add pod-warming step, tighten canary gating on pod-restarts.
ben: follow-up: we'll hold any rollouts touching autoscaler until patch landed.
tia: thanks. leaving monitoring window open for 20m; will re-open thread if things regress. :thumbsup:
